verdict.rationale: WooCommerce is described as an open-source WordPress platform that gives you "full control" of your data and lets you own your store. That implies you can pick where it is hosted, but the pack never explicitly addresses choosing a storage region or data residency. The "region-specific gateways" items concern payment providers, not data storage, so they are not relevant. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of self-hosting or hosting-location choice, residency controls for Woo-run services (e.g. WooPayments, mobile app), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
